#Module webcodecs_audio_decoder

WebCodecs AudioDecoder (src/page/bindings_audio_decoder.odin, native/js/runtime/web_webcodecs_audio_decoder.c). Wires to the audio decoders of src/media behind an honest isConfigSupported; a decoded block becomes an AudioData delivered through the output callback.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/webcodecs_audio_decoder.widl.

#Types

#handle AudioDecoder : Object

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_AudioDecoder).

#callback AudioDecoderOutput

void AudioDecoderOutput(i32 user, u64 data)

#callback AudioDecoderError

void AudioDecoderError(i32 user, i32 code)

#Functions

#AudioDecoder_create

AudioDecoder AudioDecoder_create(AudioDecoderOutput output, i32 output_user, AudioDecoderError error, i32 error_user) raises

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: AudioDecoder_create :: proc(c: ^Call, output: u32, output_user: i32, error: u32, error_user: i32) -> (u64, Api_Error)
